title: SWE-CI: Evaluating Agent Capabilities in Maintaining Codebases via Continuous Integration
authors_zh: Jialong Chen, Xander Xu, Hu Wei, Chuan Chen, Bing Zhao
paper_type_zh: 持续集成驱动的长时程代码维护基准与轨迹发布
best_for_zh: 关注软件工程智能体、CI 反馈、可执行奖励、失败轨迹、容器回放与公开轨迹复用边界的读者
one_line: SWE-CI evaluates 100 long-horizon repository evolutions from 68 public Python repositories through a 20-epoch Architect-Programmer CI loop and now releases tasks, Docker environments, code, and 115 GB of trajectories, with material split-version, verifier, completeness, replay, rights, privacy, and secret risks.
SWE-CI 以 68 个公开 Python 仓库中的 100 个长期演化任务构造最长 20 轮 Architect–Programmer CI 轨迹，并已发布任务、Docker 环境、代码及 115 GB 轨迹；但版本漂移、测试验证器、归档完整性、回放、权利、隐私和凭据隔离仍需审计。
why: It turns future-test feedback into iterative requirements, repository edits, executable outcomes, and a trajectory-level maintainability score rather than a one-shot patch verdict. The official trajectory release makes process analysis possible, but users must distinguish paper v1 from the moving v2 release and audit test quality, run health, archive coverage, licensing, sanitization, replay, and credential isolation before reuse.
inclusion_reason: SWE-CI exposes a long-horizon repository-maintenance environment where Architect and Programmer agents receive test-derived feedback, produce state-action trajectories, and are scored by executable target tests over time. Its public tasks, environments, code, and later trajectory archives make it a high-value evaluation and audit source, while release drift, public-test contamination, pytest coverage, success semantics, rights, replay, privacy, and credential-bearing execution remain central reuse boundaries.

title: Problem
问题
html:
SWE-CI, released as an arXiv preprint in 2026, asks a different question from one-shot issue repair: can an agent keep a repository functionally correct as requirements arrive over an extended code-evolution sequence? The paper's benchmark contains 100 tasks drawn from 68 public Python repositories. Each task pairs a base commit with a later target commit; the authentic history between them spans 233 days and 71 consecutive commits on average.

The task object is therefore not merely an issue and final patch. It includes two repository states, a target-test gap, a packaged source tree, a pre-built environment, and repeated Architect–Programmer interactions. A useful data record also includes requirement documents, repository snapshots, pytest reports, remaining gaps, logs, terminal state, and derived rewards. The central audit question is whether all of those run-level objects—not just task packages and headline scores—are released with enough lineage to distinguish agent failure, harness failure, and successful maintenance.

SWE-CI 于 2026 年以 arXiv 预印本形式发布，它提出了不同于一次性 issue 修复的问题：当需求沿长期代码演化序列持续到来时，智能体能否让仓库保持功能正确？论文基准包含来自 68 个公开 Python 仓库的 100 个任务。每个任务将一个 base commit 与较晚的 target commit 配对，两者之间的真实历史平均跨越 233 天和 71 个连续提交。

因此，任务对象不只是一个 issue 和最终 patch。它包含两个仓库状态、target-test gap、打包源码树、预构建环境以及反复发生的 Architect–Programmer 交互。完整可用的数据记录还应包含需求文档、仓库快照、pytest 报告、剩余 gap、日志、终止状态和派生 reward。核心审计问题是：这些运行级对象是否都带有足够血缘被公开，而不只是发布任务包与汇总分数，从而能够区分智能体失败、harness 失败和真正成功的维护。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SWE-CI turns future tests into a closed CI feedback contract. The Architect compares target-test failures with the current repository, then writes at most 5 urgent, high-level requirements. The Programmer receives that document, plans the implementation, edits the current code, and returns it for pytest evaluation. Accepted repository state and test evidence flow into the next epoch, making the consequences of earlier design decisions observable over as many as 20 epochs.

The native verifier is executable rather than judgment-based. Passed-test counts are normalized against the base and target states; current summarization averages the sequence as EvoScore with gamma 1 and separately reports Resolved, Zero_regression, and ZRR. This is a scalar reward over state transitions, not an online learned reward delivered to the model. Runner completion is also not the semantic reward: an unresolved episode that reaches the epoch cap can complete without an orchestration exception while never passing every target test.

SWE-CI 把未来测试转化为闭环 CI 反馈契约。Architect 将 target-test 失败与当前仓库进行比较，再写出最多 5 条紧急、高层需求。Programmer 接收该文档，规划实现、修改当前代码，并交回 pytest 评测。被接受的仓库状态和测试证据进入下一轮，使早期设计决策的后果能够在最多 20 轮演化中被观察。

原生 verifier 是可执行测试，而不是主观裁判。通过测试的数量相对于 base 与 target 状态进行归一化；当前汇总把序列按 gamma 1 平均成 EvoScore，并分别报告 Resolved、Zero_regression 与 ZRR。这是针对状态转移的标量 reward，不是在线发给模型的学习型奖励。Runner 完成也不等于语义成功：一个未解决 episode 到达轮数上限后，可以在没有编排异常的情况下结束，却始终没有通过全部 target tests。

title: Method
方法
html:
Construction starts from GitHub Python repositories maintained for at least 3 years, with more than 500 stars, dependency/configuration files, tests, and permissive licenses. Filtering leaves 4,923 repositories. Stable-dependency main-branch spans with at least 1,000 modified lines yield 8,311 candidate pairs; automated environment construction and self-repair retain 1,458. Executability and a target-over-base gap of at least 5 tests leave 137 candidates, from which the top 100 are selected. Final tasks average 233 days and 71 commits and contain at least 500 changed source lines excluding tests.

The evaluator uses fresh Docker containers for Architect, Programmer, and pytest stages, copying only the accepted code state forward and archiving timestamped states. Each agent call and pytest run defaults to 3,600 seconds; each agent can be retried 10 times, and evolution stops after 20 epochs or zero remaining gap. The public guidance estimates 48 hours with 16 workers on 32 CPU cores, 64 GB RAM, and about 1 GB/s disk I/O. Local records include main.log, task.log, iteration.jsonl, requirement.xml, code snapshots, test process/JSON reports, and non-passing-test context; exceptions and invalid pytest reports are logged and archived rather than silently relabeled as solved.

构建从 GitHub Python 仓库开始，要求至少维护 3 年、超过 500 stars、包含依赖或配置文件与测试，并采用宽松许可；筛选后保留 4,923 个仓库。主分支中依赖稳定且至少修改 1,000 行的跨度产生 8,311 个候选对；自动环境构建和自修复后保留 1,458 个。可执行性检查以及至少 5 个 target-over-base 测试 gap 将候选缩至 137 个，再选择排名前 100 个。最终任务平均跨越 233 天和 71 个提交，且排除测试后至少修改 500 行源码。

评测器为 Architect、Programmer 和 pytest 阶段启动新的 Docker 容器，只向前复制被接受的代码状态，并保存带时间戳的状态。每次 agent 调用和 pytest 默认限时 3,600 秒；每个 agent 可重试 10 次，演化在 20 轮或剩余 gap 为零时终止。公开指南估算：使用 16 个 worker、32 个 CPU 核、64 GB 内存和约 1 GB/s 磁盘 I/O 时需 48 小时。本地记录包括 main.log、task.log、iteration.jsonl、requirement.xml、代码快照、测试进程或 JSON 报告及未通过测试上下文；异常与无效 pytest 报告会被记录和归档，而不会被悄然改写为已解决。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates 20 models from 8 providers and reports consumption above 10 billion tokens. Most models have a zero-regression rate below 0.25, and only 2 Claude Opus models exceed 0.5. Regression frequency correlates positively with iteration count for 12 of 20 models, while regression magnitude correlates negatively for 11 of 20. These findings support the claim that sustained correctness remains difficult even when local patches improve tests.

Style evidence points in the same direction: 15 of 20 models beat human oracle code on Pylint, but every evaluated model loses on the deeper MI maintainability metric. Most models resolve fewer than 50% of tasks, and the largest gains usually occur in iterations 1–4. These are evaluation results, not proof that EvoScore fully measures maintainability. They depend on target-test coverage, deterministic execution, complete episode retention, and correct separation of semantic failure from initialization, dependency, timeout, API, or container failure.

论文评测了来自 8 个提供方的 20 个模型，并报告消耗超过 10 billion tokens。大多数模型的 zero-regression rate 低于 0.25，只有 2 个 Claude Opus 模型超过 0.5。在 20 个模型中，有 12 个的回归频率与轮数呈正相关，另有 11 个的回归幅度与轮数呈负相关。这些结果支持“即使局部 patch 改善了测试，持续正确仍然困难”的结论。

代码风格证据指向同一问题：20 个模型中有 15 个在 Pylint 上胜过 human oracle code，但全部 20 个在更深层的 MI maintainability 指标上落后。多数模型解决的任务少于 50%，最大增益通常出现在第 1–4 轮。这些是评测结果，并不能证明 EvoScore 完整测量了 maintainability；结论依赖 target-test 覆盖、确定性执行、完整 episode 留存，以及对语义失败和初始化、依赖、超时、API 或容器失败的正确区分。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinctive contribution is evaluation over an evolving repository state rather than a single issue-to-patch snapshot. A test gap is translated into an incremental requirement, the code is modified, and the resulting test state becomes the next problem. This exposes regression and accumulated technical debt that a terminal pass/fail score would hide. The public harness also preserves structured iteration records and timestamped states instead of returning only a final patch.

The release has become more useful than the original paper alone suggests. In addition to benchmark code, task archives, and Docker environments, an official 115 GB repository now claims to publish all raw experimental trajectories after light sanitization, organized across v1/v2, iFlow/OpenCode, and TDD/RDD settings. That makes process-level audit possible, but the release still lacks a machine-readable coverage and success manifest. The novelty is therefore both the CI data object and the explicit separation between task packages, executable feedback, state trajectories, and aggregate metrics.

该工作的独特贡献，是在持续演化的仓库状态上评测，而不是只看单次 issue-to-patch 快照。测试 gap 被转化为增量需求，代码随后被修改，得到的测试状态再成为下一轮问题。这样可以暴露终局 pass/fail 分数会掩盖的回归和技术债累积。公开 harness 还保留结构化 iteration 记录与带时间戳的状态，而不只返回最终 patch。

当前发布比原始论文单独呈现的内容更有复用价值。除基准代码、任务归档和 Docker 环境外，官方另有一个 115 GB 仓库，声明在轻度脱敏后发布全部原始实验轨迹，并按 v1/v2、iFlow/OpenCode、TDD/RDD 设置组织。这使过程级审计成为可能，但发布仍缺少机器可读的覆盖与成功状态清单。因此，其新颖性既在 CI 数据对象，也在清楚区分任务包、可执行反馈、状态轨迹和聚合指标。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Version and split drift. The paper's v1 benchmark has 100 tasks from 68 repositories. The release later added 126 tasks; live manifests now contain lite 50, default 100, default_v2 100, and full 226, while the dataset card still says full 137.
  • Trajectory completeness. The 115 GB trajectory repository says all raw runs are lightly sanitized, but supplies no per-task coverage, success/failure/timeout/retry index, archive schema, or paper-result mapping.
  • Success semantics. Runner success means no orchestration exception, not all tests passing. An unresolved task can stop at 20 epochs; invalid pytest output can be archived with gap -1, so resolved and failed states require explicit health labels.
  • Verifier brittleness. Weak tests permit overfitting and false positives; flaky or environment-sensitive tests cause false negatives. TDD exposes tests, RDD hides them from the Programmer, and short sequences are padded to the 20-epoch horizon.
  • Replay limits. v1 manifests include archive hashes, but compact v2/full manifests omit repository, license, and hash fields. Python 3.11 setup, apt/npm downloads, API behavior, concurrency, retries, and mutable repositories remain unpinned.
  • Rights and privacy. Runner code is Apache-2.0 and metadata is CC BY 4.0, but upstream code, tests, packages, images, and model outputs retain separate terms. “Light sanitization” has no published secret/PII method or retention policy.
  • Security. Third-party code and tests run in Docker while API keys are written into agent configuration; documented controls emphasize 8,192 MB hard memory, 4,096 MB reservation, and 128 MB/s I/O rather than network allowlisting or least privilege.

• 版本与 split 漂移。 论文的 v1 基准有来自 68 个仓库的 100 个任务。发布后来新增 126 个任务；实时 manifest 现含 lite 50、default 100、default_v2 100 和 full 226，但 dataset card 仍写 full 137。
  • 轨迹完整性。 115 GB 轨迹仓库称全部原始运行经轻度脱敏后公开，却没有逐任务覆盖、成功/失败/超时/重试索引、归档 schema 或论文结果映射。
  • 成功语义。 Runner success 表示没有编排异常，而非通过全部测试。未解决任务可在 20 轮终止；无效 pytest 输出可按 gap -1 归档，因此 resolved 与 failed 状态需要显式健康标签。
  • Verifier 脆弱性。 弱测试允许过拟合和 false positive，flaky 或环境敏感测试会造成 false negative。TDD 暴露测试，RDD 对 Programmer 隐藏测试，短序列则被填充到 20 轮 horizon。
  • 回放限制。 v1 manifest 含归档 hash，但精简的 v2/full manifest 省略仓库、许可和 hash 字段。Python 3.11 设置、apt/npm 下载、API 行为、并发、重试和可变仓库仍未固定。
  • 权利与隐私。 Runner 代码为 Apache-2.0，metadata 为 CC BY 4.0，但上游代码、测试、包、镜像和模型输出仍适用各自条款。“轻度脱敏”没有公开 secret/PII 方法或留存政策。
  • 安全。 第三方代码和测试在 Docker 中执行，同时 API key 被写入 agent 配置；公开控制主要强调 8,192 MB 硬内存、4,096 MB 预留和 128 MB/s I/O，而非网络 allowlist 或最小权限。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
SWE-CI is immediately useful for evaluation and audit. Its 100-task paper protocol, 20-epoch state sequence, executable tests, archived repository states, and 115 GB trajectory release support studies of regression, requirement synthesis, code-edit policy, verifier failure, and long-horizon agent health. The task images and hashes also make it more reproducible than a benchmark that only publishes issue text.

The evidence does not support labeling the release as a ready-made training recipe. The paper demonstrates evaluation, not SFT, RL, or reward-model optimization. The trajectories could become inputs to those methods, but only after defining a stable split, checking that failures and retries are represented, removing secrets and incidental personal data, clearing upstream and model-output rights, pinning environments, and preventing test/target leakage into evaluation. The defensible current training-use labels are evaluation and audit; any agent-training use is a new downstream protocol.

SWE-CI 可直接用于 evaluation 与 audit。论文的 100-task 协议、20 轮状态序列、可执行测试、归档仓库状态和 115 GB 轨迹发布，可支持研究回归、需求合成、代码编辑策略、verifier 失败和长时程 agent 健康度。任务镜像与 hash 也使它比只发布 issue 文本的基准更可复现。

现有证据不支持把该发布标为现成训练 recipe。论文展示的是评测，而非 SFT、RL 或 reward-model 优化。轨迹未来可以作为这些方法的输入，但首先必须定义稳定 split，检查失败与重试是否被表示，移除 secret 和偶发个人信息，核验上游及模型输出权利，固定环境，并防止测试或 target 泄漏到评测。当前可辩护的 training-use 是 evaluation 与 audit；任何 agent-training 用法都属于新的下游协议。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read arXiv v4 and treat its 100-task, 68-repository, iFlow/TDD protocol as the paper baseline; do not silently mix later release settings into paper results.
  • Inspect live manifests separately: lite has 50 tasks, default has 100, default_v2 has 100, and full has 226, despite the dataset card's stale 137 count.
  • Follow one 20-epoch record from base state through requirement.xml, code snapshots, pytest JSON, iteration.jsonl, and terminal status before interpreting EvoScore.
  • Distinguish runner completion, Resolved, Zero_regression, ZRR, timeout, invalid report, and archive presence; they are not interchangeable success labels.
  • Treat the 115 GB trajectory release as valuable but incompletely documented until archive schema, per-task coverage, failure retention, and sanitization checks are published.
  • Audit replay and security together: Python 3.11, Docker images, apt/npm builds, API keys, network policy, upstream licenses, public tests, and mutable v1/v2 splits can all change reuse conclusions.

• 阅读 arXiv v4，并把其中 100-task、68-repository、iFlow/TDD 协议作为论文基线；不要把后续发布设置悄然混入论文结果。
  • 单独检查实时 manifest：lite 有 50 个任务、default 有 100 个、default_v2 有 100 个、full 有 226 个，而 dataset card 仍保留过时的 137 计数。
  • 在解释 EvoScore 前，沿一个 20 轮记录检查 base 状态、requirement.xml、代码快照、pytest JSON、iteration.jsonl 和终止状态。
  • 区分 runner completion、Resolved、Zero_regression、ZRR、timeout、invalid report 与 archive presence；它们不是可互换的成功标签。
  • 将 115 GB 轨迹发布视为有价值但文档不完整的对象，直到 archive schema、逐任务覆盖、失败留存和脱敏检查被公开。
  • 把回放与安全一同审计：Python 3.11、Docker 镜像、apt/npm 构建、API key、网络策略、上游许可、公开测试和可变 v1/v2 split 都会改变复用结论。

value.html: Architect observations include failing-test descriptions and source context; Programmer observations include the natural-language requirement and repository. The harness also retains stdout/stderr summaries, pytest-json reports, task.log, main.log, non-passing-test files, timeout/errors, and per-epoch repository state.

value_zh.html: Architect 观察包括失败测试描述与源码上下文；Programmer 观察包括自然语言需求与仓库。harness 还保留 stdout/stderr 摘要、pytest-json 报告、task.log、main.log、未通过测试文件、timeout/错误以及逐 epoch 仓库状态。

value.html: The answer is a modified repository state produced over a sequence of CI epochs rather than a standalone text response. Evaluation reads pytest test outcomes and the time-ordered state sequence.

value_zh.html: 答案是在一序列 CI epochs 上产生的经修改仓库状态，而非独立文本响应。评测读取 pytest 测试结果与按时间排序的状态序列。

value.html: A terminal or capped repository snapshot accompanied by the archived intermediate states, requirement documents, test reports, iteration ledger, task logs, and aggregate metrics.

value_zh.html: 终态或封顶的仓库快照，附带已归档的中间状态、需求文档、测试报告、迭代账本、任务日志与聚合指标。

value.html: An Architect Agent and Programmer Agent, normally sharing the same evaluated base model, alternate inside the CI loop. The paper uses iFlow CLI as the default harness; the current code also supports OpenCode. Official trajectory archives cover named benchmark-version, harness, mode, and model combinations.

value_zh.html: 一个 Architect Agent 与一个 Programmer Agent，通常共享同一被评测基座模型，在 CI 循环内交替。论文使用 iFlow CLI 作为默认 harness；当前代码也支持 OpenCode。官方轨迹归档覆盖具名的基准版本、harness、模式与模型组合。

value.html: Each epoch records an Architect analysis that summarizes, locates, and designs requirements; a Programmer pass that comprehends, plans, and edits code; and a pytest execution. Timestamped directories preserve accepted code/test states, while iteration.jsonl records test counts, remaining gap, token/time summaries, and architect/programmer results.

value_zh.html: 每个 epoch 记录一次概括、定位并设计需求的 Architect 分析；一次理解、规划并编辑代码的 Programmer 过程；以及一次 pytest 执行。带时间戳的目录保留被接受的代码/测试状态，而 iteration.jsonl 记录测试计数、剩余缺口、token/时间摘要与 architect/programmer 结果。

value.html: Linux host orchestration loads each task's image.tar.gz, builds an agent layer, starts separate Docker containers for Architect, Programmer, and pytest work, copies the current repository state between stages, and removes containers and the derived image afterward. The published default resource guidance is 32 CPU cores, 64 GB RAM, about 1 GB/s disk I/O, and 16 workers.

value_zh.html: Linux 主机编排加载每个任务的 image.tar.gz，构建智能体层，为 Architect、Programmer 与 pytest 工作启动独立 Docker 容器，在阶段间复制当前仓库状态，之后移除容器与派生镜像。已发布的默认资源指导为 32 CPU 核、64 GB RAM、约 1 GB/s 磁盘 I/O 与 16 个 workers。

value.html: pytest and pytest-json-report yield return codes and per-test outcomes. The harness converts passed-test counts relative to base and target into normalized change, averages the sequence as EvoScore with gamma 1 in current summarization, and also reports Resolved, Zero_regression, and ZRR. Runner success/failure counters describe orchestration completion, not whether all target tests pass.

value_zh.html: pytest 与 pytest-json-report 产生返回码与逐测试结果。harness 将相对 base 与 target 的已通过测试计数转换为归一化变化，以 gamma 1 将该序列平均为 EvoScore（在当前汇总中），并还报告 Resolved、Zero_regression 与 ZRR。Runner 成功/失败计数描述编排完成，而非是否所有目标测试通过。

value.html: The principal scalar is EvoScore, based on normalized changes in passed-test counts over the fixed iteration horizon. Positive progress is normalized by the base-to-target gap and regression below the base by the base pass count. A fully resolved episode reaches the target pass count; no learned reward model or human preference label is used.

value_zh.html: 主标量是 EvoScore，基于固定迭代时程上已通过测试计数的归一化变化。正向进展按 base-到-target 缺口归一化，低于 base 的回退按 base 通过计数归一化。完全解决的 episode 达到 target 通过计数；不使用习得奖励模型或人类偏好标签。

value.html: Evolution ends when the remaining target-test gap reaches zero or after 20 epochs. Architect, Programmer, and pytest calls each default to 3,600-second timeouts; failed calls are retried up to ten times for each agent. An epoch without a valid pytest report is archived with gap -1 rather than counted as a semantically successful solution.

value_zh.html: 当剩余目标测试缺口达到零或经过 20 个 epochs 时演化结束。Architect、Programmer 与 pytest 调用各自默认为 3,600 秒超时；失败调用对每个智能体最多重试十次。无有效 pytest 报告的 epoch 以 gap -1 归档，而非计为语义上成功的解。

value.html: The official benchmark repository releases runner, prompts, Dockerfiles, and configuration. The benchmark dataset releases manifests, code.zip archives, and image.tar.gz environments. A separate 115 GB trajectory repository states that it publishes all raw experimental trajectories after light sanitization, grouped into SWE-CI v1/v2, iFlow/OpenCode, and TDD/RDD model archives. It does not publish a machine-readable coverage manifest, archive schema, per-task success/failure index, sanitization specification, or immutable paper-to-run ledger.

value_zh.html: 官方基准仓库发布 runner、提示、Dockerfiles 与配置。基准数据集发布清单、code.zip 归档与 image.tar.gz 环境。单独的 115 GB 轨迹仓库称在轻度脱敏后发布所有原始实验轨迹，分组为 SWE-CI v1/v2、iFlow/OpenCode 与 TDD/RDD 模型归档。它不发布机器可读的覆盖清单、归档 schema、逐任务成功/失败索引、脱敏规格或不可变的论文到运行账本。

value.html: Public GitHub Python repositories -> repository filters -> linear main-branch commit spans with stable dependencies -> base/target candidates -> generated and self-repaired Docker environments -> executable-test filtering -> ranked benchmark split -> dual-agent CI rollouts -> pytest verification -> released task and trajectory archives.

value_zh.html: 公开 GitHub Python 仓库 -> 仓库过滤器 -> 依赖稳定的线性主分支 commit 跨度 -> base/target 候选 -> 生成并自修复的 Docker 环境 -> 可执行测试过滤 -> 排序的基准划分 -> 双智能体 CI rollouts -> pytest 核验 -> 已发布任务与轨迹归档。

value.html: The paper evaluates 20 models from eight providers and normally uses the same model for Architect and Programmer. Exact API snapshots and a complete paper-result manifest are not supplied in the paper; current trajectory archive filenames expose additional model/version combinations beyond the paper.

value_zh.html: 论文评测来自八家提供商的 20 个模型，通常对 Architect 与 Programmer 使用同一模型。论文未提供精确 API 快照与完整论文结果清单；当前轨迹归档文件名暴露超出论文的额外模型/版本组合。

value.html: The target tests programmatically expose the current functional gap; the evaluated Architect model converts that evidence into an incremental high-level requirement document, and the evaluated Programmer model edits the repository. pytest supplies outcome labels after every epoch.

value_zh.html: 目标测试以程序方式暴露当前功能缺口；被评测的 Architect 模型将该证据转换为增量高层需求文档，被评测的 Programmer 模型编辑仓库。pytest 在每个 epoch 之后提供结果标签。

value.html: Public Python repositories and two chronologically ordered commits on the main branch. The task is defined from future target tests and current code rather than a human-written issue.

value_zh.html: 公开 Python 仓库以及主分支上两个按时间排序的 commits。任务由未来目标测试与当前代码定义，而非人类撰写的 issue。

value.html: The paper selects the top 100 of 137 surviving candidates after ranking by time span and intervening commits; this is not a random split. The current release later adds 126 tasks and a more diverse default_v2 split.

value_zh.html: 论文在按时间跨度与中间 commits 排序后选取 137 个存活候选中的前 100；这不是随机划分。当前发布随后加入 126 个任务与更多样的 default_v2 划分。

value.html: An Architect-Programmer dual-agent CI loop implemented around iFlow CLI in the paper, with current OpenCode support and TDD/RDD modes. The Architect writes no more than five urgent requirements, then the Programmer edits code before pytest verification.

value_zh.html: 论文中围绕 iFlow CLI 实现的 Architect-Programmer 双智能体 CI 循环，当前支持 OpenCode 与 TDD/RDD 模式。Architect 写不超过五条紧急需求，然后 Programmer 在 pytest 核验前编辑代码。

value.html: {'repositories_after_initial_filter': 4923, 'commit_pair_candidates': 8311, 'environment_valid_candidates': 1458, 'post_test_filter_candidates': 137, 'paper_v1_tasks': 100, 'paper_v1_repositories': 68, 'minimum_test_gap': 5, 'average_days_between_commits': 233, 'average_intervening_commits': 71, 'minimum_final_source_lines_changed_excluding_tests': 500}

Repositories must have at least three years of activity, over 500 GitHub stars, dependency/configuration files, unit tests, and a permissive license. Candidate spans retain unchanged dependencies and initially require at least 1,000 modified lines. Environments must build and run target tests; base execution must launch under the same environment; the target must pass at least five tests that the base fails. Final ranking favors longer time spans and more intervening commits.

value_zh.html: 仓库必须至少有三年活动、超过 500 个 GitHub stars、依赖/配置文件、单元测试与宽松许可。候选跨度保留未改变的依赖，并最初要求至少 1,000 行修改。环境必须构建并运行目标测试；base 执行必须在同一环境下启动；target 必须通过至少五个 base 失败的测试。最终排序偏向更长时间跨度与更多中间 commits。

value.html: The paper reports more than 10 billion consumed tokens. The default evaluator permits 20 epochs, 3,600 seconds per Architect, Programmer, and pytest call, ten retries for each agent call, and 16 concurrent workers. The repository estimates about 48 hours for the default split on the recommended host.

value_zh.html: 论文报告消耗超过 100 亿 tokens。默认评测器允许 20 个 epochs，每次 Architect、Programmer 与 pytest 调用 3,600 秒，每个智能体调用十次重试，以及 16 个并发 workers。仓库估计在推荐主机上对默认划分约 48 小时。

value.html: No policy-training or optimizer stage is demonstrated. SWE-CI is an evaluation benchmark with released trajectories; using those trajectories for SFT, RL, or reward-model training would require a new protocol, split isolation, rights review, and contamination controls.

value_zh.html: 未展示策略训练或优化器阶段。SWE-CI 是带已发布轨迹的评测基准；将这些轨迹用于 SFT、RL 或奖励模型训练将需要新协议、划分隔离、权利审阅与污染控制。

value.html: Public Python repositories, historical commits, upstream tests, generated Docker environments, target-test gaps, Architect requirement documents, Programmer repository edits, pytest reports, agent usage records, and local execution logs. Repository rights, dependency licenses, and model/API terms remain heterogeneous.

value_zh.html: 公开 Python 仓库、历史 commits、上游测试、生成的 Docker 环境、目标测试缺口、Architect 需求文档、Programmer 仓库编辑、pytest 报告、智能体用量记录与本地执行日志。仓库权利、依赖许可与模型/API 条款仍是异构的。

value.html: The paper evaluates SWE-CI v1: 100 tasks from 68 repositories. The current benchmark repository additionally exposes lite with 50 tasks, default with 100, default_v2 with 100 tasks from distinct repositories, and full with 226 tasks. The dataset card still describes SWE-CI-full as 137 tasks even though the live full.csv contains 226; the 2026-04-20 notice explains that v2 added 126 tasks.

value_zh.html: 论文评测 SWE-CI v1：来自 68 个仓库的 100 个任务。当前基准仓库另外暴露 50 个任务的 lite、100 个的 default、来自不同仓库的 100 个任务的 default_v2，以及 226 个任务的 full。数据集卡片仍将 SWE-CI-full 描述为 137 个任务，尽管当前 full.csv 含 226；2026-04-20 通知解释 v2 加入了 126 个任务。

value.html: SWE-CI uses its own base/target commit-pair construction rather than importing SWE-bench instances. No released instance-, repository-, commit-, or test-level overlap audit against SWE-bench, SWE-evo, SWE-bench-CL, or other coding benchmarks was found.

value_zh.html: SWE-CI 使用其自身的 base/target commit 对构建，而非导入 SWE-bench 实例。未发现针对 SWE-bench、SWE-evo、SWE-bench-CL 或其他编码基准的已发布实例级、仓库级、commit 级或测试级重叠审计。

value.html: No train/dev/test decontamination protocol, model-pretraining overlap measure, repository memorization probe, or hidden refresh policy is reported. Tasks are derived from public GitHub history, and current manifests disclose base and target hashes, tests, and archives, so post-release evaluation contamination is a material risk.

value_zh.html: 未报告 train/dev/test 去污染协议、模型预训练重叠度量、仓库记忆探针或隐藏刷新策略。任务派生自公开 GitHub 历史，当前清单披露 base 与 target 哈希、测试与归档，因此发布后评测污染是实质性风险。

value.html: The harness writes main.log and task.log, an initialization record, per-epoch iteration.jsonl entries, timestamped current/tmp archives, requirement.xml, code snapshots, test_result.json, pytest JSON, and non-passing-test context. Orchestration exceptions increment a failed counter and can be retried by the outer loop; completed max-epoch tasks increment runner success even when not resolved. The trajectory release claims all raw experiment trajectories were published after light sanitization, but no per-task coverage/success manifest or retention policy proves that every successful, failed, timed-out, retried, or corrupted run is represented.

value_zh.html: harness 写入 main.log 与 task.log、初始化记录、逐 epoch 的 iteration.jsonl 条目、带时间戳的 current/tmp 归档、requirement.xml、代码快照、test_result.json、pytest JSON 与未通过测试上下文。编排异常使失败计数加一，并可被外层循环重试；已完成的 max-epoch 任务即使未解决也会使 runner 成功计数加一。轨迹发布声称所有原始实验轨迹在轻度脱敏后均已发布，但无逐任务覆盖/成功清单或保留策略证明每一个成功、失败、超时、重试或损坏的运行都被代表。

value.html: Partial. Commit hashes, source/image archive hashes in v1 manifests, packaged task environments, and archived intermediate states help. However the official repositories have no paper-bound release tag; v2/full omit repository/license and archive-hash columns; the derived agent image runs unpinned apt/npm steps; API model behavior, dependencies, hardware, concurrency, retries, and timeouts can drift. A 115 GB archive is evidence of release, not proof of deterministic record-and-replay.

value_zh.html: Partial。v1 清单中的 commit 哈希、源/镜像归档哈希、打包的任务环境与已归档中间状态有帮助。然而官方仓库没有论文绑定的发布标签；v2/full 省略仓库/许可与归档哈希列；派生的智能体镜像运行未固定的 apt/npm 步骤；API 模型行为、依赖、硬件、并发、重试与超时可能漂移。115 GB 归档是发布的证据，而非确定性记录与回放的证明。

items: Most models resolve fewer than half of tasks despite the long interaction budget.
Regression frequency rises with iteration count for many models.
Surface-level Pylint quality can improve while deeper maintainability measured by MI remains worse than human code.
Initialization, API concurrency, agent timeout, pytest timeout, dependency, and Docker failures can prevent comparable evaluation.
Runner-complete, semantically resolved, zero-regression, and archive-present are distinct success states.
Live benchmark manifests and trajectory archives drift beyond the paper's v1 protocol.
尽管交互预算很长，多数模型仍解决不到一半任务。
对许多模型，回归频率随迭代次数上升。
表层 Pylint 质量可以改善，而由 MI 衡量的更深可维护性仍差于人类代码。
初始化、API 并发、智能体超时、pytest 超时、依赖与 Docker 失败可阻止可比评测。
Runner-complete、semantically resolved、zero-regression 与 archive-present 是不同的成功状态。
实时基准清单与轨迹档案漂移超出论文的 v1 协议。

value.html: Tasks originate from public repositories rather than a disclosed collection of private users. Nevertheless, source history, test logs, agent prompts, paths, URLs, and model outputs can contain author identities, credentials, or other incidental data. The trajectory release says it is lightly sanitized for desensitization but does not document the detector, redaction fields, review coverage, retention period, opt-out procedure, or privacy takedown policy.

value_zh.html: 任务来自公开仓库，而非已披露的私有用户集合。然而，来源历史、测试日志、智能体提示、路径、URLs 与模型输出可包含作者身份、凭证或其他附带数据。轨迹发布称其为脱敏而轻度净化，但未记载检测器、脱敏字段、审查覆盖、保留期限、退出程序或隐私下架政策。

value.html: The evaluator executes third-party repository code and tests in Docker and writes model API credentials into agent configuration files inside containers. iFlow configuration disables its own sandbox, OpenCode grants allow permission, and documented container arguments focus on CPU, memory, and I/O limits rather than a network allowlist. Reuse therefore needs secret rotation, egress control, non-root and capability restrictions, malicious-test/package defenses, archive scanning, and verification that released logs do not retain secrets.

value_zh.html: 评测器在 Docker 中执行第三方仓库代码与测试，并将模型 API 凭证写入容器内的智能体配置文件。iFlow 配置禁用其自身沙箱，OpenCode 授予 allow permission，所记载的容器参数聚焦于 CPU、内存与 I/O 限制而非网络允许列表。因此复用需要密钥轮换、出站控制、非 root 与能力限制、恶意测试/包防御、档案扫描，以及核验已发布日志不保留密钥。

value.html: The SWE-CI runner is Apache-2.0. Benchmark metadata is CC BY 4.0; redistributed code remains under each upstream repository license; environment curation is Apache-2.0 while included operating-system and package components retain their own terms. The trajectory repository declares Apache-2.0, but that label does not automatically clear embedded upstream code, model outputs, test logs, or third-party dependencies for unrestricted training reuse.

value_zh.html: SWE-CI runner 为 Apache-2.0。基准元数据为 CC BY 4.0；再分发代码仍受各上游仓库许可约束；环境策展为 Apache-2.0，而所含操作系统与软件包组件保留其自身条款。轨迹仓库声明 Apache-2.0，但该标签并不自动清除嵌入的上游代码、模型输出、测试日志或第三方依赖以便不受限制的训练复用。

value.html: The paper reports 4,923 repositories after initial filtering, 8,311 candidate commit pairs, 1,458 executable environments, 137 candidates after automated test filtering, and the top 100 v1 tasks. The release lacks the rejected-item ledger, exact search snapshot, construction seeds, self-repair change log, immutable candidate-to-v2 mapping, and paper-to-trajectory coverage manifest.

value_zh.html: 论文报告初始过滤后 4,923 个仓库、8,311 个候选 commit 对、1,458 个可执行环境、自动测试过滤后 137 个候选，以及前 100 个 v1 任务。发布缺少被拒绝条目账本、精确搜索快照、构建种子、自修复变更日志、不可变候选到 v2 映射，以及论文到轨迹覆盖清单。

value.html: Code, task manifests, packaged repository states, pre-built environments, and large trajectory archives are public. The release is mutable and versioned by repository commits rather than a paper-bound tag; trajectory archives are opaque compressed files without a public schema or checksummed mapping from every paper result to task, model, success state, and expected file inventory.

value_zh.html: 代码、任务清单、打包的仓库状态、预构建环境与大型轨迹归档是公开的。该发布是可变的，按仓库 commits 而非论文绑定标签版本化；轨迹归档是不透明的压缩文件，没有公开 schema，也没有从每条论文结果到任务、模型、成功状态与预期文件清单的带校验和映射。

items: Exact paper-result matrix and immutable mapping from every reported run to a released trajectory archive and per-task record.
Machine-readable trajectory archive schema, required-file inventory, success/failure/timeout/retry labels, and completeness checks.
Exact light-sanitization procedure, secret/PII scanner, false-negative audit, retention, and takedown policy.
Full rejected-candidate ledger, repository search snapshot, self-repair edits, ranking tie-breaks, and v1-to-v2 deduplication lineage.
Pinned OCI or agent-layer digests, apt/npm snapshots, model API snapshots, concurrency schedule, random seeds, and deterministic replay tests.
Repository-, commit-, and test-level overlap with other coding benchmarks and model-pretraining contamination.
Item-level rights validation for every redistributed source archive, environment component, test log, and model-generated trajectory.
精确论文结果矩阵，以及从每次所报告运行到已发布轨迹档案与逐任务记录的不可变映射。

items: Passing target tests is a narrow proxy: incomplete or weak tests create false positives, while flaky, order-dependent, platform-sensitive, or timeout-prone tests create false negatives.

Agents can overfit visible tests in TDD mode. RDD hides the tests from the Programmer, but the Architect still derives requirements from test failures, so benchmark-specific behavior may replace general maintainability.

Current EvoScore summarization uses gamma 1 and pads a short trajectory with its last available pass count to the 20-epoch horizon. Early failure, voluntary termination, and missing later evidence therefore require separate health reporting rather than interpretation from the scalar alone.

Runner success means that the task process returned without an orchestration exception; it includes unresolved episodes that simply reached the epoch cap. It must not be confused with Resolved or all target tests passing.

A pytest run with return code above 1, no JSON report, or timeout is archived with an invalid gap rather than normal test evidence. Dependency and container failures can therefore mix with agent capability failures.
Public target commits, tests, manifests, benchmark code, and trajectory archives permit direct benchmark-specific tuning and answer reconstruction.
通过目标测试是狭窄代理：不完整或弱测试造成假阳性，而不稳定、顺序依赖、平台敏感或易超时的测试造成假阴性。
智能体可在 TDD 模式中过拟合可见测试。RDD 对 Programmer 隐藏测试，但 Architect 仍从测试失败推导需求，因此基准特定行为可能取代一般可维护性。
当前 EvoScore 汇总使用 gamma 1，并将短轨迹用其最后可用通过计数填充至 20-epoch 时程。因此早期失败、自愿终止与缺失后续证据需要单独的健康报告，而非仅从该标量解释。
Runner 成功意味着任务进程在无编排异常的情况下返回；它包括仅达到 epoch 上限的未解决 episode。不得与 Resolved 或全部目标测试通过混淆。
返回码大于 1、无 JSON 报告或超时的 pytest 运行以无效 gap 归档，而非正常测试证据。因此依赖与容器失败可与智能体能力失败混合。
公开的目标 commits、测试、清单、基准代码与轨迹档案允许直接进行基准特定调优与答案重建。
